name: Dead Bug

instructions.description: Lie on the back with hips and knees bent and arms reaching upward.
Gently brace the abdomen while breathing.
Lower the opposite arm and leg only as far as trunk position can be maintained.
Return to the start and alternate sides.

variations.variationDescription: Dead Bug — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Dead Bug — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Reduce limb reach if the lower back lifts excessively.
